method: Original deterministic integer pixel geometry in Java, without bitmap inputs. Match the community steel/teal casing and hatch palette. Reuse W275's original Java cylinder drawing with a separately coloured nitrogen band and its existing drawn port icons. No vanilla, upstream or third-party bitmap is copied, traced, sampled or transformed. Pinned vanilla clients are read only for screening and external comparisons.
planned_scope: Replace only live vanilla stand-in faces with functional machine drawings and a station-deployment-kit icon; preserve the already replaced electrolyzer front and OBJ rocket motor and fuel tank.
Rebind all 24 remaining drawer-side models to the W275 machine panel; retain the approved baseline casing image byte-for-byte.
Bind each W275 port's existing type icon to its side and bottom as well as its top, making all six faces identifiable.
A separately named nitrogen cylinder icon with a blue band; retain all W275 images and earlier reviews unchanged.
Texture-only v1.8 model bindings. No geometry, IDs, behaviour, recipes, loot, build scripts, ledger, queue, status files or historical resource changes.
